blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Video generation models can create realistic-looking video footage from images and text prompts. Some of the recent advances have raised concerns about the reproduction of copyrighted visual content. However, copyright leakage detection in generated videos remains largely unexplored.
  In this paper, we introduce a new benchmark data set for copyright leakage detection, comprising 50 copyrighted concepts, each with 5 images. For each concept, we have 5 videos created using the image+prompt video generation model and the prompt-only video generation model. Following that, we develop an AI toolset based on a contrastive retrieval framework that formulates copyright leakage detection as a video-to-image retrieval problem by matching aggregated video frame embeddings against a database of copyrighted image embeddings. Our method uses a single similarity threshold and retrieves the most similar copyrighted reference as supporting evidence.
  We conducted experiments showing strong retrieval and detection performance, achieving 99.6\% detection accuracy with only a single false negative. These results show the effectiveness of the retrieval-based method for scalable and explainable copyright leakage detection in AI-generated videos. Data can be accessed publicly from https://zenodo.org/records/21386117 and the source code for this project is publicly available at https://github.com/Shaif95/video-cp-Leakage.
blocks.zh:
视频生成模型可以从图像和文本提示中创建现实的外观视频镜头. 最近的一些进展引起了人们对版权视觉内容复制的关注. 然而,在生成的视频中发现版权泄漏的情况基本上仍未得到探讨。
在本文中,我们引入了一套新的版权泄漏探测基准数据集,包含50个版权概念,每个概念有5个图像. 对于每个概念,我们有5个视频使用图像+即时视频生成模型和即时视频生成模型创建. 之后,我们开发了基于对比性检索框架的AI工具集,通过将嵌入的汇总视频帧与版权图像嵌入数据库相匹配,将版权渗漏检测定为视频到图像检索问题. 我们的方法使用一个单一的相似性阈值,并检索最相似的版权引用作为佐证.
我们进行了试验,显示有很强的检索和探测性能,达到99.6XX的探测精度,只有一种假阴性. 这些结果显示了基于检索的方法在AI生成的视频中可伸缩和可解释的版权泄漏检测的有效性. 数据可在https://zenodo.org/records/21386117上公开查阅。 该项目的源代码可在https://github.com/Shaif95/video-cp-leakage上公开查阅。

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en: Figure 1: Example copyrighted concepts and their five reference images used to build the reference database, showing the pose, lighting, and style variation the encoder must be invariant to.
blocks.zh: 图 1: 实例版权概念及其用于构建参考数据库的五个参考图像,显示的姿势,照明,和风格变化编码器必须不易变换.

blocks.en: Recent advances in generative AI have made it relatively easy to create realistic digital content across modalities such as images, video, graphics, websites, art, and news media [ 1 ] . Within Computer Vision, AI-generated content has become one of the most important areas of research. Generative adversarial models initially gained popularity for their ability to generate photorealistic images. Following that, diffusion models [ 1 ] and autoregressive transformers have emerged as the most successful models for image generation. Based on the capability of diffusion models, several video generation models have been developed. These include text-to-video [ 2 ] , image-to-video, video-to-video [ 3 ] , video-editing, video generation [ 4 ] conditioned on image+text and many other video generation applications. With these impressive video generation capabilities, there are several legal and ethical challenges that we have to address. Recent research has shown that image and video generation models can recreate copyrighted content from the internet or other sources [ 5 , 6 ] . In this paper, we focus on conditioning-based copyright propagation, where a copyrighted reference image is supplied as input to an image-to-video (I2V) pipeline; training-based memorization, where a model reproduces content memorized from its training data, is outside the scope of this work. We introduce a dataset for copyright detection in AI-generated video. Along with that, we propose a contrastive retrieval-based method for copyright detection. The goal is to provide a baseline and open dataset to promote more research in this area, leading to fair use of video generation models.
blocks.zh: 最近基因AI的进步使得在图像,视频,图形,网站,艺术,和新闻媒体等模式中创建现实的数字内容相对容易. [1]. 在"计算机视野"(Computer Vision)中,AI生成的内容已经成为最重要的研究领域之一. 基因对抗模型最初因其能够生成光现实主义图像而获得欢迎. 之后,扩散模型[1]和自动递归变压器成为图像生成最成功的模型. 根据传播模型的能力,开发了多个视频生成模型. 其中包括以图像+文本和许多其他视频生成应用为条件的文本到视频[2],图像到视频,视频到视频[3],视频编辑,视频生成[4]. 有了这些令人印象深刻的录像制作能力,我们必须应对若干法律和道德挑战。 最近的研究显示,图像和视频生成模型可以从互联网或其他来源重现版权内容[5,6]. 在本文中,我们侧重于基于条件的版权传播,即提供有版权的参考图像,作为图像到视频(I2V)管道的投入;基于培训的记忆,即一个模型复制从其培训数据中记住的内容,不属于本工作的范围。 我们在AI生成的视频中引入了一个用于版权检测的数据集. 与此同时,我们提出一种基于对比性检索的方法来检测版权。 目标是提供一个基线和开放数据集,以促进这一领域的更多研究,从而公平使用视频生成模型。

blocks.en: I-A Background and Motivation
blocks.zh: 背景和动机

blocks.en: Stability AI is a company that has emerged as the leading model provider for image and video generation using AI. Currently, Stability AI is facing several lawsuits in the U.S. and the UK for scraping images to train its generative AI model, Stable Diffusion. One of the landmark lawsuit by Getty images alleged that Stability AI has used 12 million of its photographs, captions, and metadata without permission [ 5 ] . As evidence, they have shown that earlier versions of Stable Diffusion sometimes replicated Getty watermarks. Another lawsuit by Disney, NBCUniversal, and Warner Bros. against Midjourney focuses on the generation of copyrighted material by AI models. The studios allege that the AI platform mass-infringed their intellectual property by training models on copyrighted works to let users generate unauthorized, high-quality images and videos of iconic characters [ 7 , 5 ] .
blocks.zh: 稳定AI是一家以AI为主的图像和视频生成模式提供者的公司. 目前,稳定AI正面临美国和联合王国的几起诉讼,要求刮掉图像以训练其基因化AI模型"稳定扩散". Getty的一桩划时代的官司指控稳定AI未经许可使用1200万张照片、标题和元数据[5]。 作为证据,他们已经表明,早期的"稳定扩散"版本有时会复制盖蒂水印. 迪士尼,NBC Universal,和华纳兄弟公司的另一起诉讼. 反对Midjourney则专注于AI模型的版权材料的生成. 工作室指称,AI平台大规模侵犯他们的知识产权,对版权作品模式进行培训,让用户生成未经授权的高质量图像和偶像人物视频[7,5].

blocks.en: In this paper, we have created a dataset for copyright leakage detection in AI-generated video, with 50 copyrighted concepts, 5 reference images each, and 5 videos per concept from both image-conditioned and prompt-only generators. We also propose a contrastive retrieval method that detects leakage by matching video frame embeddings against a database of copyrighted image embeddings. This way, instead of just giving a yes/no answer, our framework can also point out which exact copyrighted image is being leaked. Both are released as an open baseline to support fairer video generation research.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们在AI生成的视频中创建了用于版权泄漏检测的数据集,其中包含50个有版权的概念,每个有5个参考图像,每个概念有5个视频来自图像条件的和快速的生成器. 我们还提出一种对比性检索方法,通过将嵌入的视频帧与版权图像嵌入的数据库匹配来检测渗漏. 这样,我们的框架不仅没有给出一个是/否的答案,而且还可以指出哪些有版权的图像被泄露。 两者都作为开放基线发布,以支持更公平的视频生成研究.

blocks.en: I-B Limitations of Existing Copyright Detection Methods
blocks.zh: 现有版权探测方法的局限性

blocks.en: Existing research on copyright leakage detection focuses on image generation [ 8 ] . While image generation has a significant risk of copyright infringement [ 9 , 8 ] , video generation can often generate copyrighted characters as well as personal identities. This makes it necessary to focus on the detection of copyrighted content for video-based models. Existing research also lacks open data sets necessary for continued research [ 8 , 7 , 5 , 10 ] . We aim to establish an introductory benchmark and tool chain that can encourage more work in this area.
blocks.zh: 现有版权泄漏探测研究侧重于图像生成[8]. 虽然图像生成有很大的侵犯版权的风险[9,8],但视频生成往往可以产生版权人物和个人身份. 这使得有必要专注于检测基于视频的模型的版权内容. 现有研究也缺乏继续研究所必需的开放数据集[8、7、5、10]。 我们的目标是建立一个可鼓励在这一领域开展更多工作的入门基准和工具链。

blocks.en: I-C Contributions
blocks.zh: 捐款

blocks.en: The main contributions of this work are summarized as follows:
blocks.zh: 这项工作的主要贡献概述如下:

blocks.en: • We introduce a new benchmark data set for conditioning-based copyright leakage detection in AI-generated videos, consisting of 50 copyrighted concepts, reference images, and paired image-conditioned and prompt-only generated videos. • We provide a simple, reproducible retrieval baseline that formulates copyright leakage detection as a video-to-image retrieval problem by matching aggregated video frame embeddings against a database of copyrighted reference image embeddings. Rather than proposing a new architecture or loss, we deliberately build on standard components (a ResNet-18 encoder trained with SupCon and nearest-neighbor search) so that the benchmark is paired with a transparent and easily extensible pipeline. We also establish an evaluation protocol for copyright leakage detection using both retrieval and classification metrics. • Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed framework, achieving high retrieval performance and a detection accuracy of 99.6% on the proposed benchmark. Together, this data set and the AI tool set can encourage more research in this area and lead to mitigation methods.
blocks.zh: • 支助 我们在AI生成的视频中引入了一套新的基于条件的版权泄漏检测基准数据集,由50个版权概念,参考图像,以及配对的图像条件和快速生成的视频组成. 我们提供了一个简单,可复制的检索基线,将版权渗漏检测定为视频到图像检索问题,将嵌入的汇总视频帧与版权参考图像嵌入的数据库相匹配。 我们没有提出新的架构或损失,而是刻意利用标准组件(经过SupCon和最近的邻国搜索培训的ResNet-18编码器),使基准与透明和易于扩展的管道配对。 我们还利用检索和分类衡量标准,建立了版权泄漏检测评价协议。 • 广泛的试验显示拟议框架的有效性,实现高检索性能,检测准确度达到拟议基准的99.6%。 本数据集和AI工具集一起可以鼓励这一领域的更多研究并导致缓解方法.

blocks.en: We introduce a new benchmark data set for conditioning-based copyright leakage detection in AI-generated videos, consisting of 50 copyrighted concepts, reference images, and paired image-conditioned and prompt-only generated videos.
blocks.zh: 我们在AI生成的视频中引入了基于条件的版权渗漏检测的新基准数据集,由50个版权概念,参考图像,以及配对的图像条件和快速生成的视频组成.

Rather than proposing a new architecture or loss, we deliberately build on standard components (a ResNet-18 encoder trained with SupCon and nearest-neighbor search) so that the benchmark is paired with a transparent and easily extensible pipeline. We also establish an evaluation protocol for copyright leakage detection using both retrieval and classification metrics.

Together, this data set and the AI tool set can encourage more research in this area and lead to mitigation methods.

blocks.en: II Related Work
blocks.zh: 二. 相关工作

blocks.en: II-A Video Generation Models
blocks.zh: II-A 视频生成模型

blocks.en: Diffusion models have emerged as the dominant paradigm for state-of-the-art high-fidelity video generation. Building on image diffusion, Video Diffusion Models [ 11 ] and Make-A-Video [ 2 ] extended denoising generation to the temporal domain, and more recent latent video diffusion approaches such as Stable Video Diffusion [ 1 ] scaled this to high-resolution, image-conditioned generation. In parallel, powerful text-to-image (T2I) diffusion models such as SDXL [ 12 ] have become widely adopted as keyframe generators in video production pipelines, whereas dedicated video generation frameworks, including AnimateDiff [ 13 ] , ModelScopeT2V [ 4 ] (and its community fine-tuned derivative Zeroscope), and CogVideoX [ 14 ] , support both text-to-video (T2V) and image-to-video (I2V) synthesis. A defining property of these models is that they are conditioned on external images or text and trained on large web-scraped corpora, through which copyrighted visual content can propagate into their outputs. Concretely, copyrighted visual content may enter a generated video through two distinct mechanisms: training-based memorization, in which representations learned from a web-scale corpus reappear in outputs, and conditioning-based propagation, in which the visual identity of a reference image or prompt is preserved through the generation pipeline. The latter mechanism, prevalent in image-to-video and key-frame-driven production workflows, remains relatively underexplored and is the focus of this work.
blocks.zh: 传播模式已成为最先进的高诚信视频生成的主要范例。 在图像传播的基础上,视频传播模型[11]和Make-A-Video[2]将解析生成扩展至时间域,以及更近一些的潜在视频传播方法,如稳定视频传播[1],将其缩放为高分辨率,图像条件的生成. 同时,SDXL[12]等强大的文本对映(T2I)传播模式在视频制作管道中被广泛采用为键框生成器,而专用的视频生成框架,包括AnimateDiff[13],ModelScopeT2V[4](及其社区微调衍生的零视镜),CogVideoX[14],支持文本对映(T2V)和图像对映(I2V)的合成. 这些模型的一个界定属性是,它们以外部图像或文字为条件,并接受大型网络破烂的corpora的培训,通过这种培训,有版权的视觉内容可以传播到其产出中. 具体地说,版权的视觉内容可能通过两种不同的机制输入生成的视频:基于培训的记忆,其中从网络规模实体中汲取的表述重新出现在产出中;基于条件的传播,其中参考图像的视觉特征或通过生成管道保存。 后一种机制在图像到视频和关键框架驱动的生产工作流程中普遍存在,但这种机制仍然相对没有得到充分利用,是这项工作的重点。

blocks.en: II-B Copyright, Memorization, and Replication in Visual Generative Models
blocks.zh: II-B 版权、记忆和视觉基因模型复制

blocks.en: The question of whether visual generative models reproduce copyrighted content has moved from a legal concern to an active research problem [ 15 , 7 ] . A growing body of work shows that large-scale diffusion models do not merely generalize but can memorize and reproduce individual training examples. Notably, Carlini et al. [ 10 ] demonstrated that near-verbatim copies of training images can be extracted from diffusion models, while Somepalli et al. [ 5 ] showed that a non-trivial fraction of generated images are partial or full replications of specific training samples, detectable by retrieving the nearest training image for each generation. Follow-up work analyzed the causes of this behavior and proposed mitigations at generation time [ 16 , 17 ] . A complementary, mitigation-oriented line removes protected visual concepts or styles from the model itself through concept erasure [ 18 ] or concept ablation [ 19 ] . However, existing approaches almost exclusively address the training-based replication channel, operating on static images, matching generated images against training images in a single modality, and typically assuming access to the model or its training data. In contrast, the conditioning-based propagation channel, where a copyrighted reference is deliberately supplied as input to an I2V pipeline, and the video setting more broadly remain relatively underexplored. Yet this setting is a growing and legally salient risk: modern production workflows routinely animate reference frames into full sequences, and the resulting videos may reproduce protected characters, costumes, or cinematic identities without authorization. Crucially, whether such propagation is legally infringing is a downstream determination; the technical task we address is to flag and attribute candidate reproductions to a reference database, providing an interpretable audit signal rather than a legal verdict
blocks.zh: 视觉基因模型是否复制版权内容的问题,已经从法律关注转移到了积极的研究问题[15,7]. 越来越多的工作显示,大规模传播模式不仅概括,而且能够记住和复制个别培训实例。 值得注意的是,Carlini等人。 [10] 证明可以从传播模型中提取培训图像的近Verbatim拷贝,而Somepalli et al. [5] 显示生成的图像的非三角部分是特定训练样本的部分或完全复制,通过检索每代最近的训练图像可探测. 后续工作分析了这种行为的原因,并提出了代代缓解[16,17]. 一个互补的,面向缓解的线条通过概念消除[18]或概念消除[19],从模型本身中去除受保护的视觉概念或风格. 然而,现有方法几乎完全针对基于培训的复制渠道,在静态图像上运行,将生成的图像与单一模式的培训图像相匹配,并通常假定可以访问模型或其培训数据。 与此相反,基于条件的传播频道,即作为I2V管道输入而故意提供版权参考的频道,以及更广泛的视频设置,仍然相对未得到充分利用。 然而,这种设定是一个越来越大的、法律上突出的风险:现代制作工作流程通常将动画参考框成完整的序列,由此产生的视频可能会不经授权而复制受保护的角色、服装或电影身份。 关键的是,这种传播是否合法违反是一项下游决定;我们处理的技术任务是标注候选人的复制品并将其归入参考数据库,提供可解释的审计信号,而不是法律判决

blocks.en: II-C Contrastive Representation Learning
blocks.zh: II-C 矛盾代表性学习

blocks.en: Contrastive representation learning has emerged as a dominant paradigm for self-supervised feature extraction, mapping data into a latent embedding space where positive pairs are pulled together while negative pairs are pushed apart, yielding representations invariant to nuisance transformations such as cropping, color jitter, and blur [ 20 , 21 , 22 , 23 ] . Supervised contrastive learning (SupCon) [ 24 , 25 ] generalizes this objective to leverage label information, pulling together all samples sharing a class while separating differing classes, which produces tighter, more cluster-structured embeddings. Beyond hand-crafted augmentations, self-distillation methods such as DINO [ 26 ] learn similarly discriminative features without negatives, and large vision-language models such as CLIP [ 27 ] provide strong general-purpose embeddings from image–text contrast. Overall, the invariance and instance-discriminative structure induced by these contrastive objectives are precisely the properties needed to recognize the same copyrighted identity across pose, lighting, and stylistic variations introduced by generative pipelines, making contrastive representations a natural foundation for a similarity-based leakage detector.
blocks.zh: 矛盾表现学习已成为自我监督的特征提取的主导范例,将数据映射到潜在的嵌入空间中,其中正对子被拉在一起,而负对子被推开,从而产生不常见的表示,导致诸如作物栽培、色彩紧张和模糊[20、21、22、23] 等干扰性转变。 监督的对比性学习(SupCon)[24,25]将这一目标概括为杠杆化标签信息,将共享一个类的所有样本集合在一起,同时分离不同的类,这会产生更紧凑,更集群结构的嵌入. 除了手工增强外,DINO [26] 等自我消化方法也学会了类似的不带负数的歧视性特征,而CLIP [27] 等大型视觉语言模型提供了强烈的通用嵌入从图像-文本对比的嵌入. 总体而言,这些对比目标引起的变化和实例差别结构恰恰是确认不同姿势、照明和基因管引入的形而上学的相同版权特性所需的属性,使对比性表述成为基于相似性的渗漏探测器的自然基础。

blocks.en: II-D Cross-Modal and Video Retrieval
blocks.zh: II-D 跨潮汐和视频检索

blocks.en: Detecting copyrighted content through similarity search is closely related to content-based copy detection, which seeks to identify near-duplicate or transformed versions of a reference item. In the image domain, the DISC21 benchmark [ 9 ] spurred descriptors robust to strong edits, most notably SSCD [ 6 ] , a self-supervised copy-detection embedding that treats copy detection as instance-level retrieval. In the video domain, segment- and video-level copy detection has been studied on large benchmarks such as VCSL [ 28 ] , and cross-modal retrieval methods built on contrastive vision–language embeddings [ 27 , 3 ] match content across text, image, and video. However, in generated videos, frames may deviate from any real reference through synthesis artifacts, motion, and stylistic drift. Thus, matching it against static, real copyrighted images is an inherently asymmetric and cross-domain problem. Moreover, conditioning-based propagation preserves identity (character, costume, palette) rather than pixels, requiring identity or visual concept-level rather than instance-level matching. We address both by aggregating per-frame embeddings into a single video-level representation and retrieving against a concept-structured reference database.
blocks.zh: 通过相似性搜索检测版权内容与基于内容的复制检测密切相关,该检测旨在识别一个参考项的近似复制或变换版本. 在图像域中,DISC21基准[9]激发了强力描述器进行强力编辑,最显著的是SSCD[6],一种自行监督的复制检测嵌入,将复制检测视为实例级检索. 在视频领域,对VCSL[28]等大型基准进行了分段和视频层面的复制检测研究,在对比视觉-语言嵌入[27,3]上搭配了跨文本,图像和视频的内容。 然而,在生成的视频中,帧可能通过合成文物、运动和结构漂移而偏离任何真实参考。 因此,将它与静态,真实的版权图像相匹配,是一个固有的不对称和跨域问题. 此外,基于条件的传播保留了身份(特征、服装、调色板)而不是像素,要求身份或视觉概念级别而不是实例级别匹配。 我们既通过将每个框架嵌入一个单一的视频级别代表,又通过一个概念结构化的参考数据库检索,来解决问题。

blocks.en: To the best of our knowledge, there is no open-source dataset available for research on copyright leakage and potentially illegal video generation. No existing framework performs retrospective, model-agnostic detection and tracing of copyrighted visual content in generated video via video-to-image retrieval. This gap between the growing risk of copyright leakage and the lack of dedicated tools directly motivates the benchmark and framework proposed in this paper.
blocks.zh: 据我们所知,没有开放源码数据集可供研究版权泄漏和潜在的非法视频生成。 现有任何框架都没有通过视频到图像检索对生成的视频中的版权视觉内容进行追溯、模型不可知检测和追踪。 版权流失风险与缺乏专门工具之间的这一差距直接推动了本文件提出的基准和框架。

The two branches together form the final benchmark.

blocks.en: III Method
blocks.zh: 三、结 论 方法

blocks.en: Figure 3: Overview of the proposed retrieval-based copyright detection framework. Reference images and generated video frames are mapped into a shared embedding space by a contrastive encoder (ResNet-18 trained with SupCon). The resulting video embedding is compared against the reference database, and a copyright leak is declared when its similarity to the nearest reference exceeds a threshold τ \tau .

blocks.en: III-B Benchmark Dataset
blocks.zh: 三-B 基准数据集

blocks.en: The benchmark is developed using K = 50 K{=}50 copyrighted concepts, each with 5 images collected from archive.org , resulting in a total dataset of 250 images. For each concept, we generate 5 videos using the video generation model with a prompt and an image as input. These 250 videos become positive samples for copyright leakage videos. We also create 250 videos based on 50 different concepts using only the text prompt as input to the video generation model. These become the negative samples for copyright leakage.

blocks.en: III-C Contrastive Image Representation Learning
blocks.zh: III-C 对比图像表现学习

blocks.en: We have used contrastive learning to generate embeddings from the images and videos. Given an input anchor image, contrastive learning generates an augmented view and learns representations by maximizing agreement between the anchor and positive sample, while increasing the distance between the anchor and negative sample in the feature space. Contrastive learning has an encoder that can be used to generate representations from images and videos. The encoder backbone is a ResNet-18 followed by a projection head g ϕ g_{\phi} , producing z = g ϕ ​ ( f θ ​ ( I ) ) / ∥ g ϕ ​ ( f θ ​ ( I ) ) ∥ z=g_{\phi}(f_{\theta}(I))/\lVert g_{\phi}(f_{\theta}(I))\rVert . We chose ResNet-18 deliberately: with only 250 reference images, a compact backbone reduces the risk of overfitting during contrastive training and keeps frame-level screening computationally inexpensive. Larger foundation backbones such as CLIP [ 27 ] or DINOv2 [ 26 ] are natural drop-in replacements that we leave for future work. For each image, we create two augmented views and train with the supervised contrastive loss: ℒ SupCon = − 1 N ∑ i = 1 N 1 | P ⁡ ( i ) | ∑ p ∈ P ⁡ ( i ) log exp ⁡ ( z i ⋅ z p / τ ) ∑ a ∈ A ⁡ ( i ) exp ⁡ ( z i ⋅ z a / τ ) \mathcal{L}_{\text{SupCon}}=-\frac{1}{N}\sum_{i=1}^{N}\frac{1}{|P(i)|}\sum_{p\in P(i)}\log\frac{\exp(z_{i}\cdot z_{p}/\tau)}{\sum_{a\in A(i)}\exp(z_{i}\cdot z_{a}/\tau)}

blocks.en: III-E Video Representation
blocks.zh: 三-E 视频代表

blocks.en: We extract frames from every video { F t } t = 1 T \{F_{t}\}_{t=1}^{T} , and every frame is passed through the same encoder f θ f_{\theta} to obtain frame embeddings { u t } \{u_{t}\} . We compute the average of these features to create a single video-level embedding. v = 1 T ​ ∑ t = 1 T u t / ∥ 1 T ​ ∑ t = 1 T u t ∥ , v=\frac{1}{T}\sum_{t=1}^{T}u_{t}\Big/\Big\lVert\frac{1}{T}\sum_{t=1}^{T}u_{t}\Big\rVert, (1) This feature summarizes the video’s overall visual identity while remaining directly comparable to reference embeddings in 𝒟 \mathcal{D} . Retrieval is therefore performed in a shared image embedding space (video-to-image retrieval) rather than through full spatio-temporal video modeling. Frame averaging suits the conditioning-based setting, where the copyrighted identity (character, costume, palette) is carried by appearance and persists across frames. However, it discards temporal order, so infringement expressed only through motion or sequence (e.g., choreography or a specific animated sequence) is beyond the scope of this work.

blocks.en: III-F Copyright Leakage Detection
blocks.zh: III-F 版权泄漏探测

blocks.en: Given a video embedding v v , we compute its similarity to every entry in the image feature database 𝒟 \mathcal{D} as s ⁡ ( v , z ) = v ⊤ ​ z s(v,z)=v^{\top}z and retrieve the nearest reference z ⋆ = arg ⁡ max z ∈ 𝒟 ⁡ s ⁡ ( v , z ) z^{\star}=\arg\max_{z\in\mathcal{D}}s(v,z) . Using that image, we also fetch the nearest concept label c ⋆ c^{\star} . The video is declared a copyright leak of c ⋆ c^{\star} if s ⁡ ( v , z ⋆ ) ≥ τ s(v,z^{\star})\geq\tau , and clean otherwise. So that τ \tau becomes the parameter that directly controls the sensitivity of detection. Because the decision is based on nearest neighbor search, the framework also returns the specific copyrighted concept, providing retrieved reference evidence for each decision rather than an opaque label. This output is a screening signal for human or legal review, not a determination of infringement or fair use, which depends on legal factors such as transformative use that a similarity score cannot capture.

blocks.en: IV Results
blocks.zh: 四. 结果

blocks.en: IV-A Dataset
blocks.zh: IV-A 数据集

blocks.en: The benchmark comprises 50 copyrighted concepts and 50 original non-copyright concepts, each with 5 generated videos, giving 500 videos in total across the image-conditioned and prompt-only pipelines. Fig. 1 shows example concepts with their five reference images. Videos are decoded frame-by-frame, resized to 224 × 224 224\times 224 , and normalized before they are passed to the ResNet-18 encoder trained with contrastive learning. Each video is represented by the average of features and compared against the reference database via cosine similarity. 40% of the videos were used to create the decision threshold, and the rest were used for testing and analysis. We report binary classification accuracy, precision, recall, and confusion metrics computed on the held-out test set using the threshold learned on the training split.
blocks.zh: 基准由50个版权概念和50个非版权原概念组成,每个概念有5个生成的视频,通过图像条件化和快速化的管道总共提供500个视频。 图1以五个参考图像显示实例概念。 视频逐帧解码,大小调整为224×224/224\times 224,并在通过对比性学习而训练的ResNet-18编码器传递之前实现规范化. 每段视频均以平均功能表示,并通过余弦相似度与参考数据库进行比较. 40%的视频用于创建决定阈值,其余用于测试和分析. 我们报告二进制分类精度、精度、召回率和混淆度量度,这些度量度是使用在培训分拆时学到的门槛计算出来的。

blocks.en: IV-B Copyright Detection Results
blocks.zh: 版权检测结果

blocks.en: Using a threshold of τ = 0.77 \tau=0.77 selected on the training split, our method achieves 99.6% accuracy on the test set, with 138 of 139 copyright videos correctly flagged and all 112 non-copyright videos correctly cleared. This corresponds to a precision of 100% and a recall of 99.3%, with only a single false negative and zero false positives. Fig. 5 shows that the similarity scores of copyright and non-copyright videos form two well-separated distributions, with the learned threshold falling cleanly in the gap between them.
blocks.zh: 使用在训练分拆中选择的= 0.77\ tau=0.77的阈值,我们的方法在测试集中实现了99.6%的精度,139个版权视频中有138个正确标注,112个非版权视频全部正确清除. 这相当于100%的精确度和99.3%的召回率,只有一个虚假的负数和零虚假的正数. 图5显示版权与非版权视频的相似性分数形成两个分明的发行,学到的阈值在它们之间的间隙中干净落下.

blocks.en: Figure 7: t-SNE projection of generated video embeddings. Copyright videos (triangles) and non-copyright videos (squares) occupy largely distinct regions of the space.
blocks.zh: 图7:T-SNE对生成的视频嵌入的投影. 版权录像(三角形)和非版权录像(平方形)基本上占据了空间的不同区域。

blocks.en: IV-C Retrieval Results
blocks.zh: 四-C 检索结果

blocks.en: Beyond the binary decision, our framework returns the specific reference image responsible for the highest similarity score, allowing each detected copyright leak to be traced back to a source image. In practice, the top-ranked retrieval consistently corresponds to the correct ground-truth concept for copyright videos, confirming that the embedding space is discriminative enough for localization and not just detection. Fig. 6 visualizes the learned reference image embeddings with UMAP, showing that images of the same copyrighted concept are grouped together. Fig. 7 shows the corresponding t-SNE projection of generated video embeddings, where copyright and non-copyright are clustered in different regions with few overlaps.
blocks.zh: 在二进制决定之外,我们的框架返回负责最高相似性分数的特定参考图像,允许每个被检测到的版权泄露可以追溯到源图像. 在实践中,排名最高的检索与版权视频的正确地面真实概念一致,确认嵌入空间足以对本地化产生歧视,而不仅仅是检测. 图6将学到的参考图像与UMAP嵌入,显示相同版权概念的图像被组合在一起. 费格。 7显示生成的视频嵌入的对应的t-SNE投影,其中版权和非版权被分组在不同区域,几乎没有重叠.

blocks.en: IV-D Qualitative Results
blocks.zh: 定性结果

blocks.en: Fig. 4 shows some example frames from the generated videos. The image-conditioned videos (top two rows) visibly preserve the identity, costume, and color palette of their copyrighted reference, while the prompt-only videos (bottom two rows) depict generic characters with no identifiable source. This contrast shows the difference in similarity scores between copyright and non-copyright videos.
blocks.zh: 图4显示了从生成的视频中的一些实例框架. 图像条件化的视频(上两行)明显地保留了他们版权参考文件的身份,服装和色调,而即时的视频(下两行)则描绘了没有可识别来源的通用字符. 这种对比显示了版权与非版权视频在相似性分数上的区别.

blocks.en: IV-E Comparison with Standard Classifiers
blocks.zh: IV-E 与标准分类符的比较

blocks.en: To compare against standard classifiers, we used the same ResNet-18 + SupCon encoder, reference database, and train/test split as the proposed method. Each video was represented by a cosine similarity vector computed between its embedding and all reference image embeddings (250 dimensions for the copyright-only database and 440 dimensions after adding non-copyright references). Logistic Regression, Linear SVM, Random Forest, and feature-space k-NN were trained using these similarity vectors, while the proposed retrieval method and image-database k-NN directly queried the reference database at inference time. Thus, all methods used identical features and differed only in their decision strategy; this experiment isolates the effect of the decision rule rather than comparing against state-of-the-art video copy detection descriptors such as SSCD [ 6 ] or frozen foundation-model embeddings such as CLIP [ 27 ] and DINOv2 [ 26 ] , which we leave for future work. Table I shows that the proposed retrieval-based thresholding approach consistently outperformed all competing methods.
blocks.zh: 为了与标准分类器进行比较,我们采用了与拟议方法相同的ResNet-18 + SupCon编码器,参考数据库,以及列车/测试拆分. 每段视频均以其嵌入和所有参考图像嵌入之间的余弦相似矢量(仅版权数据库的250维,加上非版权引用后的440维)为代表. 逻辑回归、线性SVM、随机森林和特征空间k-NN都利用这些相似性矢量进行了培训,而拟议的检索方法和图像数据库k-NN则在推断时直接询问参考数据库。 因此,所有方法都使用相同的特征,只在决策策略上有所不同;这一实验隔离了决定规则的效果,而不是与SSCD[6]等最先进的视频拷贝检测描述符进行比较,或者与CLIP[27]和DINov2[26]等冷冻的基建嵌入符进行比较,我们离开后再做这项工作. 图表 我显示,拟议的基于检索的阈值方法一贯优于所有相互竞争的方法。

blocks.en: IV-F Ablation Study, Limitations and Future Work
blocks.zh: 四-F 关系研究、限制和未来工作

blocks.en: In this paper, we use two different strategies to analyze video embeddings: feature averaging across all frames and taking the maximum per-frame similarity to the database. The late fusion of feature averaging allows a smoother, more stable similarity score, while max-frame similarity allows it to be more interpretable.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们使用两种不同的策略来分析视频嵌入:在所有帧的特性平均值和最大每个帧与数据库相似度. 特性平均率的后期聚变允许更平滑,更稳定的相似性得分,而最大帧的相似性则允许它更能解释.

blocks.en: Beyond the detection framework and experiments, the value of this benchmark lies in its paired construction: because every copyrighted concept has a matched non-copyright counterpart generated with the same pipeline, it provides a controlled comparison for examining image conditioning. However, the benchmark should be viewed as a controlled pilot study: with 50 concepts, 250 reference images, and 500 videos, its scale is small, and results may not transfer to in-the-wild user-generated videos, to subtler forms of copying such as style or likeness imitation, or to videos from unknown generators. The 99.6% accuracy may also be influenced by the controlled data set construction, and frame averaging does not capture infringement expressed only through motion. In addition, we have not yet evaluated robustness to common evasion edits such as cropping, color jittering, additive noise, or inpainting, which a deployed copyright detector must withstand. Our method also relies on a single embedding model, and evaluating alternative embeddings is an important direction for future work. A further deployment consideration is the privacy of user-provided reference images and audited videos. Extending copyright leakage detectors to a federated setting [ 29 , 30 , 31 , 32 ] is therefore a promising direction for privacy-preserving auditing across content platforms. In addition, future work could investigate lightweight and compression techniques [ 33 , 34 , 35 , 31 ] to reduce the computational cost of frame-level copyright screening frameworks, thereby enabling on-device decision-making and advancing edge intelligence in AI-based copyright-auditing systems.
blocks.zh: 除了检测框架和实验之外,这个基准的价值在于其配对构造:由于每个版权概念都有匹配的非版权对应物与同一管道产生,它为检查图像配置提供了可控比较. 然而,该基准应该被看作是一种可控的试点研究:有50个概念,250个参考图像,500个视频,其规模很小,结果可能不会转移到用户生成的闪闪发光的视频,到风格或相似仿真等更微妙的复制形式,或者转移到未知生成器的视频. 99.6%的精度也可能受到控制数据集构造的影响,帧平均不会只捕捉通过运动表达的侵犯. 此外,我们尚未评估是否稳健到通常的逃避编辑,例如作物栽培、彩色振荡、添加剂噪音或涂料,而部署的版权探测器必须承受这些影响。 我们的方法还依赖于单一的嵌入模型,评价替代嵌入是未来工作的一个重要方向. 另一个部署考虑是用户提供的参考图像和经审计的视频的隐私。 因此,将版权泄漏探测器扩展至联邦机构[29、30、31、32],是整个内容平台的隐私保护审计的有希望的方向。 此外,今后的工作可以调查轻量级和压缩技术[33,34,35,31],以减少帧级版权筛选框架的计算成本,从而使得能够在基于AI的版权审计系统中进行在线决策和推进边缘智能.

blocks.en: We release the data set, trained models, source code, reference embeddings, and evaluation protocol openly, in the hope of encouraging further research into detection and, ultimately, mitigation strategies that allow video generation models to be developed and deployed more fairly.
blocks.zh: 我们公开发布数据集、训练有素的模型、源代码、参考嵌入和评价协议,希望鼓励进一步研究探测,并最终制定减缓战略,以便更公平地开发和部署视频生成模型。

blocks.en: V Conclusion
blocks.zh: 五 结论

blocks.en: In this paper, we address a largely unexplored problem: detecting conditioning-based copyright leakage in AI-generated video, where a copyrighted reference image is propagated through an image-to-video pipeline. As video generation models become stronger, they are increasingly capable of creating realistic video conditioned on copyrighted images and prompts. The models are able to reproduce protected characters, artwork, real human identities, etc. This creates legal and ethical concerns for model developers, platforms, and rights holders alike. To address this gap, we introduced a new benchmark data set of 50 copyrighted concepts, each paired with reference images and videos. We also create a set of non-copyright videos generated through an identical pipeline. This paired construction helps examine the role of image conditioning in copyright leakage and enables precise, reproducible evaluation.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们讨论了一个基本上没有探讨的问题:在AI生成的视频中检测基于条件的版权泄漏,通过图像到视频的管道传播版权的参考图像。 随着视频生成模式的加强,它们越来越能够以版权图像和提示为条件制作现实的视频。 这些模型能够复制受保护的人物,艺术品,真实的人类身份等. 这给模型开发者、平台和权利持有者造成了法律和道德方面的关切。 为了弥补这一差距,我们采用了一套新的基准数据,由50个版权概念组成,每个概念都配有参考图像和视频。 我们还通过一个相同的管道制作了一套非版权录像。 这种配对构造有助于审查图像条件在版权泄漏中的作用,并促成精确,可复制的评价.

blocks.en: Beyond copyright, this paper connects to the deepfake video problem, where generated videos are misused for impersonation and misinformation. Our retrieval approach can be extended for identity verification and content provenance too. We release our complete tool set, including the data set, models, embeddings, source code, and evaluation protocol, publicly. Future work includes extending detection to training-based memorization, where text-to-video models reproduce copyrighted content without image conditioning, exploring mitigation such as concept erasure, and testing robustness against adversarial evasion. We hope this encourages more research towards safer video generation. The data set will be publicly released upon publication; the data set link is omitted from the current submission to preserve anonymity.
blocks.zh: 除了版权之外,本文还连结了深假视频问题,其中生成的视频被误用于冒充和误导. 我们的检索方法可以扩展 身份验证和内容来源。 我们公布完整的工具集,包括数据集、模型、嵌入、源代码和评价协议。 今后的工作包括:将检测范围扩大到基于培训的记忆,即文本到视频模型在不设定图像条件的情况下复制版权内容,探索概念消除等缓解措施,测试对抗性逃逸的稳健性。 我们希望这能鼓励更多的研究,以便制作更安全的视频。 数据集将在发布后公开发布;当前提交中省略了数据集链接,以保持匿名.
